label: Carbohydrate degradation
description: Catabolic GIFTs acting on polysaccharides, neutral monosaccharides, amino sugars or uronates.
interpretation: Measures the supported repertoire in the current curated carbohydrate catalogue; it is not total carbohydrate metabolism, substrate use, growth or activity.

label: Plant fibre utilisation
description: GIFTs curated with a fibre-degradation role, including polymer processing, uptake and intracellular catabolism of released sugars.
interpretation: Measures encoded fibre-associated capabilities; it does not show that fibre is available, consumed or degraded in situ.

label: Host glycan foraging
description: GIFTs acting on host-derived glycans or the sugars released from them.
interpretation: Current membership covers released-sugar catabolism rather than complete mucin or host-glycan depolymerisation.

label: Carbon acquisition
description: GIFTs that convert an acquired substrate into central carbon metabolism.
interpretation: Measures a curated catabolic repertoire, not carbon-use efficiency, growth yield, flux or environmental substrate availability.

label: Aromatic catabolism
description: GIFTs that activate, cleave or funnel aromatic rings toward central metabolism.
interpretation: Counts independently meaningful aromatic-catabolic capabilities; it does not prove complete mineralisation unless the required connected GIFTs are all supported.

label: Nitrogen acquisition
description: GIFTs whose curated role makes nitrogen available from inorganic or organic sources.
interpretation: Measures encoded acquisition chemistry, not nitrogen limitation, uptake rate, assimilation rate or growth.

label: Sulfur acquisition
description: GIFTs whose curated role makes sulfur available from inorganic or organic sources.
interpretation: Measures encoded acquisition chemistry, not sulfur limitation, uptake rate, assimilation rate or growth.

label: Fermentation products
description: GIFTs that form a curated terminal fermentation product.
interpretation: Measures the repertoire of encoded product-forming chemistry; it does not establish fermentation, secretion, product concentration or flux.

label: Short-chain fatty acids
description: GIFTs whose curated substrate or product class is a short-chain fatty acid.
interpretation: Covers formation and interconversion capabilities and must not be read as an SCFA production rate or concentration.

label: Vitamin biosynthesis
description: GIFTs participating in curated vitamin and cofactor biosynthetic capabilities.
interpretation: Richness counts atomic capabilities, not the number of complete vitamins a genome can synthesize from environmental precursors.

label: Released bioactive products
description: GIFTs whose chemistry forms a product curated as potentially bioactive when released.
interpretation: The GIFT establishes product-forming chemistry only; release, concentration and an effect on a host or community are not inferred.

label: Chemical detoxification
description: Defense GIFTs implementing a complete curated chemical-detoxification mechanism.
interpretation: Measures encoded mechanisms, not exposure, expression, survival or resistance under a particular condition.

label: Shikimate-derived biosynthesis
description: Biosynthetic GIFTs whose product carbon skeleton is derived from the shikimate pathway.
interpretation: Membership describes biosynthetic family provenance; richness does not prove that every connected product pathway is complete.

label: biomass-essential anabolic GIFTs
description: Anabolic GIFTs whose declared output is a curated biomass-essential anchor.
interpretation: Coverage is the fraction of assessable curated biomass-essential anabolic capabilities supported, not proof of growth without supplementation.

label: Amino-acid autonomy
description: Biomass-essential anabolic GIFTs in the amino-acid substrate class.
interpretation: Coverage measures supported curated amino-acid anabolic capabilities, not prototrophic growth in a specified medium.

label: Nucleotide autonomy
description: Biomass-essential anabolic GIFTs in the nucleotide substrate class.
interpretation: Coverage measures supported curated nucleotide anabolic capabilities, not growth, nucleotide pool size or salvage independence.

label: Cofactor autonomy
description: Biomass-essential anabolic GIFTs in the cofactor substrate class.
interpretation: Coverage measures supported curated cofactor anabolic capabilities, not cofactor sufficiency, uptake independence or growth.

label: Extracellular processing outputs
description: Metabolic GIFTs derived as consuming and releasing extracellular anchors.
interpretation: Identifies encoded extracellular processing interfaces; public-good use, sharing and ecological benefit are not inferred.

label: Nutrient uptake
description: Metabolic GIFTs derived as moving an extracellular anchor to a cytoplasmic anchor.
interpretation: Measures curated uptake capabilities, not transport rate, substrate availability or uptake activity.
